rule office_application_spawns_encoded_powershell {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting"
    description = "Detects an Office application starting PowerShell with an \"-enc\" (encoded) command line, a common macro dropper pattern."
    severity = "High"
    priority = "High"
    tactic = "TA0001,TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.001,T1566.001"
    opentide_uuid = "00000000-0000-4000-8003-000000000061"
    opentide_version = "3"
    data_source = "Microsoft Sysmon"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    // Office parent: Word, Excel, or PowerPoint.
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\\(winword|excel|powerpnt)\.exe$/ nocase
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\powershell\.exe$/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\s-e(nc|ncodedcommand)?\s/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 70
    $host = $e.principal.hostname
    $command_line = $e.target.process.command_line

  condition:
    $e
}
